Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
The Tournament Winning Deck Archive is now hosted on the V:EKN France website.

www.veknfrance.com/decks/twd.htm

I'm currently performing a tidy-up operation on it and adding as much missing information as possible (such as the number of players for pre-2002 tournaments).

Concurrently, I'll update it with the new TWDs (since October 26th).

I'll also maintain the Hall of Fame.

I'm aware the Secret Library also hosts the TWD. It's better to have two sources of TWD in case the new TWDA or Secret Library stops being updated.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
